line: We've a great deal of nothing ahead of us. Mrs. Kross had her probe in my throat. I thought I was going to weep coolant. Well. My intake trunk.
Long crossing, and no one else in it. Ferro once had his hands on my injector rail, and I almost lost pressure entirely.
Long way still to run. Dalley had her hands on me once. Heated seal iron, and I nearly lost pressure entirely.
We've a great deal of nothing ahead of us. Mister Ovin once had his hands on my access ports. Nano vibration gun, and I thought I was going to leak coolant.
Hours of this left, Captain. Bexley had a nano vibration gun. Felt like she was trying to wake me up. Almost lost pressure entirely.
Long crossing, and no one else in it. Tam used a slow pressure flush on my manifold. I nearly lost pressure entirely. Took a while for the seals to settle.
Plenty of time before anything happens. Doctor Hesse worked on my coupling housings. Nano vibration gun. I thought I was going to leak coolant.
We've a great deal of nothing ahead of us. Sella Rusk had a hand buffer on my docking collar. I nearly vented. She didn't flinch.
Long crossing, and no one else in it. Mrs. Kross had her inside me, once. Fine magnetic pick, slow work. I thought I was going to leak coolant.
We've a great deal of nothing ahead of us. Ferro once had his fingers in my manifold. Nearly drew a vacuum before he found the right angle.
